outcome: Positive molecular genetic test for osteopetrosis
cohort: A single 6-month-old female patient presented with dysmorphic features, failure to thrive, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, anemia, and thrombocytopenia.
finding: A 6-month-old female patient presented with a constellation of symptoms including dysmorphic features and bone marrow abnormalities, ultimately leading to the diagnosis of malignant infantile osteopetrosis confirmed by molecular genetic testing.
